incidentResponse.summary: Monitor /api/health, exclude raw health questions from logs, review content-source changes, and roll back to the last approved content bundle if safety or source integrity is questioned.
incidentResponse.rollback: Redeploy the previous container image and approved data bundle.
incidentResponse.severity: Escalate immediately if urgent-care warnings fail, official resource links are compromised, or admin content approval is bypassed.
